statement: Pharmaceutical-style page in four rows, each starting with a tall red two-section jar with a green lid at the left margin and writing on it. Row 1: 12 separate roots or root-like parts (one a cluster of six open tubes, one a long segmented root with many leg-like rootlets). Row 2: 7 parts (a figure-eight twist, an arch, a bulb with a V-shaped sprout, a stack of coils, a root with a fan of spikes, a small tuft, a large root with tendrils). Row 3: 7 parts (crossed speckled legs, a dark red dripping bulb, a tailed root, a stack of bands, an S-shaped hairy rhizome, a curled banded part, a broom-like fibre mass under one large green leaf); the third jar stands on three short curled feet. Row 4: one whole plant, a long segmented orange root with a thin stem branching to about eight arrow- or heart-shaped green leaves and two hanging dark red clusters. The transcription's container lines f99r.1, 19, 32, 45 are given to the four jars, since each is written on its jar; the single part line of row 4 (f99r.46) goes to the row-4 plant. Rows 1-3 have 12, 8 and 8 part labels (f99r.2-14 with one two-line label, 20-27, 33-40) for 12, 7 and 7 parts. Labels sit next to the stalks, but whether each belongs to the part on its left or its right could not be settled from the scan alone, so those parts carry their row's block as label_group and label null.
